plans.description: Restore the rider-bob animation first, since the injected fault reports animation_not_started:rider-bob, and verify motion before touching the horse.
plans.goal: Change the rider-bob animateTransform begin from begin="indefinite" to begin="0s" while leaving dur, values, keyTimes, repeatCount, and all artwork untouched, then run wukong.verify to confirm wukong.changed becomes true and no new errors appear.

plans.description: After the rider moves, restore the horse-gallop animation, which was also paused, without altering the horse geometry.
plans.goal: Change the horse-gallop animateTransform begin from begin="indefinite" to begin="0s" while preserving dur="0.8s", values, keyTimes, repeatCount, and all horse paths, then run wukong.verify to confirm white-dragon-horse.changed becomes true and the structure contract passes.

plans.description: If either single-begin change still leaves a paused animation, normalize both animation begins together so both SMIL timelines start at document load.
plans.goal: Set both rider-bob and horse-gallop begin attributes to begin="0s" in one patch, keep every other attribute and all artwork identical, then run wukong.verify to confirm both wukong and white-dragon-horse report changed:true with zero errors and warnings.

finalChoice.rationale: Both candidates share the same verified SHA-256 and passed browser checks with identical artwork geometry and motion; shadow/align-both-begins is the feasible incremental choice with lower wall time (16062 ms vs 22047 ms) and no observed failures.
